task.description:
Step 4b — validate the test design artefact for ISS-0125. HARD GATE: TEST-RUNNER cannot start until PASS.

Run per-artefact checks (mandatory):
  python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration/iss0125_cascade_test.zig   # exit 0, no BLOCKER

Then verify (manual hard-gate checks):
1. Every MUST requirement of ISS-0125 has a runnable integration test file (not a deferred test, not a placeholder).
2. No `error.SkipZigTest` on any test in iss0125_cascade_test.zig. (A skipped MUST test = requirement stays PENDING.)
3. All fixtures use per-test UUIDs (grep the file — confirm no hardcoded tenant IDs / process_definition IDs).
4. Tests clean up after themselves (use defer h.deinit() pattern; TestHarness rollback-on-deinit isolation).
5. Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent (the file checks the env var and reports a clear error, OR it relies on TestHarness.init which already does this — confirm either way).
6. (MAJOR — does not block PASS, but must be noted) Pipeline step: check `docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §11.10` for the pipeline inventory. If any of the surfacing tests (TC-ISS-202-02/05, TC-ISS-203-03/04/05, TC-ISS-601-01..09, TC-EE-08-04, TC-EE-10-04/05/06, TC-EXP-202-01/02/03, TC-ES-03-01) has a UI-flow counterpart that requires pl.step(), confirm it. (Most are backend tests with no UI pipeline.)

If all 5 hard checks pass AND no BLOCKER/MAJOR from lint: PASS.
If any hard check fails: FAIL with precise list.

result.summary: PASS — lint exited 0 with no isolation issues. Hard check 1 PASS: all four ISS-0125 MUST acceptance criteria map one-to-one to runnable TC-ISS-0125-01 through TC-ISS-0125-04 test blocks. Hard check 2 PASS: no error.SkipZigTest. Hard check 3 PASS: fixture IDs use per-test std.crypto.random UUIDs, with no hardcoded UUID or process_definition ID. Hard check 4 PASS: all four tests immediately register defer h.deinit(), whose rollback-on-deinit provides cleanup. Hard check 5 PASS: every test calls requireTestDatabaseUrl, which prints a clear message and returns error.MissingTestDatabaseUrl; TestHarness.init independently enforces the same contract. Pipeline assessment: the listed surfacing tests are backend integration tests and no current UI-flow pipeline applies.
